scope: Actual deployed envelope and moving frame members, seven layouts. Read-only audit. No manufacturer mechanism claim.

changeLedger.coverage: Roof rotation, nested wing floor + wall rotation and rotating end panels. All four major deployment elements animated.
changeLedger.limits: Original chain uses wall height greater than wing width without lift/clearance offsets; not a validated collision-free or manufacturer mechanism.

changeLedger.coverage: Roof and floor fixed open. Side walls rotate alone. End panels slide from outside ends.
changeLedger.reasonForUserRegression: The full deployment demonstration became only the last envelope assembly stages.

changeLedger.coverage: Complete rigid visual deployment restored with temporary sliding clearances and outward rotating end flaps.
changeLedger.finalTransforms: All moving mesh world matrices at expansion p=1 exactly equal the same model in Exterior mode.

observations: Four images show roof wings open before side wall elevation.
An intermediate scene has a windowed side panel horizontal on the wing.
A subsequent scene has longitudinal walls upright and ends open.
The final scene shows a closed envelope.
notEstablished: Match to the 6220 × 11800 mm plan variant

equations.notation: s = wing side ±1, f = front/rear ±1; C=1.1, X=3.11, Z=5.9, H=2.55 metres. R is a rigid rotation. All phase functions use clamped smoothstep.
equations.floor: alpha=(pi/2)(1-floor); anchor=(s(C+.45 sin(alpha)), .55 sin(alpha),0); rotate Rz(s alpha).
equations.posts: Same pivot rotation as wall; local base x gains s*.02*(1-postsDock), local z gains sign(baseZ)*.18*(1-postsDock). These are explicit independent sliding placement assumptions.
equations.ends: theta=(pi/2)(1-ends); anchor=(s(C+.15 sin(theta)^2),0,f(Z+.30(1-ends))); rotate Ry(-s f theta).
equations.endpoint: Every added translation and rotation is zero at p=1 relative to its reference anchor.

verification.method: Actual transformed connected mesh-component OBB SAT with 0.1 mm excess-over-final-baseline threshold. Final structural joints retained as explicit baseline contacts, not hidden claims of fabrication clearance.
verification.baselineDisclosure: Final roof/profile/post construction volumes and floor/support contacts overlap in this visual solid model. They are listed explicitly, retained pair-by-pair, and are not evidence of fabrication clearance. No additional sampled penetration above baseline + 0.1 mm was found.

fixedFindings: Postes com Z original atravessavam os topos fixos do núcleo até 94 mm.
Deslocar postes para dentro em Z fazia-os atravessar a própria parede longitudinal.
Cobertura baixa antes das paredes erguidas introduzia até 3.42 mm de penetração.
Postes colocados fora em Z, com folga lateral local de 20 mm, e assentamento depois do fecho dos topos eliminam os excessos detectados.
A folga axial dos topos de 300 mm evita a sobreposição inicial com postes afastados 180 mm.
limits: Discrete sampled test, not a continuous collision proof or manufacturing tolerance.
Connected-component boxes conservatively bound the actual triangular geometry; holes and curved surfaces may be overestimated.
Only geometry displayed during Expansion is audited. Interior partitions, furnishings, electrical and plumbing are hidden and are not shown folded or packed.
Support/joint construction detail, hardware, locks, structural strength, tolerances and transportation logistics remain unverified.
All clearances are presentation hypotheses. Numeric confidence intervals cannot be inferred from the unmeasured source image.
